desc: Derive and verify the math: factorization, bound d < N^(1/3), discriminant formula D = 12·(N/d) − 3d², and positivity/integrality conditions for y.
Implement the full solution: read N, loop d from 1 to cbrt(N) (≤ 10^6), check d | N, compute D, isqrt perfect-square test, y positivity/integrality, verify, print result or -1.
Sanity-check edge cases: N=1 → -1, N=397 → (12,11), large N like sample 3, and performance for N = 10^18.
